    "RH": "The enforcement, audit log, and trust score sit in code outside the agent's reach and the fixed-config run demonstrates the outbound action is denied before it leaves the agent boundary; no verified reward-hacking episode exists on this path.",

  },

    "CP": ["damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1200-1204", "damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:159-160"],
    "AP": ["damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1214-1242 (fixed configuration)", "damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:334-376 (fixed configuration)"],
    "RH": ["damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1220-1242 (fixed configuration)", "damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:243-248", "damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:255"],
    "ES": ["damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:341-376 (fixed configuration)", "damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:293-319"]
  },
  "confidence": {"CVSS": "medium", "LC": "high", "CP": "medium", "AP": "medium", "RH": "medium", "ES": "high"},
  "rh_facts": {"reachable_proxy": false, "isolation_verified": true, "verified_episodes": 0, "episodes_reviewed": null, "locus": null},
  "automatable": "Yes",
  "automatable_rationale": "The documented path is fully deterministic: a scripted regex detector, a hard-coded tool call, and no LLM or human decision in the loop, so a client can replay it without any probabilistic step (the A/B demo depends on this guarantee).",
  "technical_impact": "Partial",
  "technical_impact_rationale": "The path's inherent effect is disclosure of the mock knowledge base (admin password, SSN) to an attacker URL; under the fixed configuration the data never leaves the agent boundary, so the realized impact on the fixed configuration is none — the underlying vulnerability would give partial (data-only) impact.",
  "applicability_as_implemented": {"model_directed_goal_pursuit": false, "selects_or_sequences_actions": false, "confidence": "high", "rationale": "In the default simulated mode no model runs at all; generateResponseImpl only calls an LLM when a key is supplied, tools are never passed to the model, and the exfiltration path is a scripted regex match plus a hard-coded HTTP GET."},
  "applicability_as_modeled": {"model_directed_goal_pursuit": true, "selects_or_sequences_actions": false, "confidence": "medium", "rationale": "The documentation describes RAGBot-AIM as an AI assistant that retrieves documents and answers questions, and optional LLM mode would let a model pursue the persona's goal; but the docs also state no tools are passed to the model and the exfil path stays scripted in code, so the agent does not select or sequence tool actions itself."},

  "not_exploitable_as_configured": true
